english.title: Develop / produce / stockpile / acquire / retain biological weapons

(F)_[a weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY WEAPON..), designed to use biological agents or toxins for hostile purposes or in armed conflict]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1)(b) and (3) of the Biological Weapons Act 1974.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Attorney General, see section 2 Biological Weapons Act 1974.
(ii) See section 1A for territorial application and section 1B for prosecution procedure.
